title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about booking your Brussels Airport taxi transfer.
description_secondary: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact our support team—we're happy to help.

items.question: How will I find my driver at Brussels Airport?
items.answer: Your chauffeur will meet you in the arrivals hall holding a sign displaying your name.

items.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
items.answer: We monitor all incoming flights and adjust pickup times accordingly at no extra charge.

items.question: Are your prices fixed?
items.answer: Yes. All airport taxi transfer prices are fixed and confirmed before your journey.

items.question: Can I book a transfer for a group?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer Mercedes V-Class and premium minivan options for larger groups.

items.question: Do you provide child seats?
items.answer: Yes, child and booster seats are available upon request.

items.question: Can I book a return transfer?
items.answer: Yes, both one-way and round-trip airport transfers can be arranged.
